<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Страница-1" id="g-EWpWef9zyEFPYrNQuw"> <mxGraphModel dx="1689" dy="1079" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR
 SW[\"Switch<br/>LoggerClient\"]
 CMS[\"Card-Management<br/>OutboxProcessor\"]
 LOG[\"Transaction Logger<br/>TransactionLogListener\"]
 NS[\"Notification Service<br/>CardEventListener\"]

 subgraph rmq[\"RabbitMQ\"]
 subgraph f1[\"Поток транзакций\"]
 EX1{{\"EXCHANGE smp.transactions<br/>topic, durable\"}}
 Q1[\"QUEUE transaction-log<br/>durable, DLX, x-max-delivery=3\"]
 DLX1{{\"DLX smp.transactions.dlx<br/>direct\"}}
 DLQ1[\"DLQ transaction-log-dlq<br/>TTL 60000 ms\"]
 end
 subgraph f2[\"Поток событий карт\"]
 EX2{{\"EXCHANGE smp.card-events<br/>topic, durable\"}}
 Q2[\"QUEUE card-notifications<br/>durable, DLX, x-max-delivery=3\"]
 DLX2{{\"DLX smp.card-events.dlx<br/>direct\"}}
 DLQ2[\"DLQ card-notifications-dlq<br/>TTL 60000 ms\"]
 end
 end

 SW -->|\"publish key=transaction.log<br/>confirm: correlated<br/>по ТЗ 2 с, callback в коде нет\"| EX1
 EX1 -->|\"binding transaction.log\"| Q1
 Q1 -->|\"consume → store()\"| LOG
 Q1 -.->|\"отказ после 3 доставок\"| DLX1
 DLX1 -->|\"key=transaction-log\"| DLQ1

 CMS -->|\"publish key=card.EventClass<br/>Outbox retry до 3 → FAILED\"| EX2
 EX2 -->|\"binding card.*\"| Q2
 Q2 -->|\"consume → INSERT card_notifications\"| NS
 Q2 -.->|\"отказ после 3 доставок\"| DLX2
 DLX2 -->|\"key=card-notifications\"| DLQ2
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
